title: kotoba-os Genesis Manifest (the node DNA)
description: ADR-2606031600 §D1 boot model. The content-addressed manifest a kotoba-os node boots from: 'boot a CID, reconstruct its Datom state, join the neighbourhood'. Names the kernel image, the userland WASM Component-Model actor(s) + their content-addressed validation rules (the Holochain-style membrane), the capability-scoped device/world imports, the delegated identity (NO server-held key, C3/N5), the mesh neighbourhood, and the safety posture (soft-RT only N2, no live actuation N3 at R0; civilian-only N1).

cid.description: CIDv1, base32 multibase (blake3 per kotoba-core). Loose draft pattern — not full multibase validation.

witInterface.description: An interface from the kotoba:os WIT package (00-contracts/wit/kotoba-os/kotoba-os.wit). Capability-scoped: a node may import only what it lists here.

edge.description: The L1 lower edge this manifest targets (ADR §five-layer model). L3-L5 are identical across edges; only L1/L2 differ.

userland.description: One or more content-addressed WASM Component-Model actors (L5). Each carries the CID of its validation-rule component (the membrane/DNA) and the kotoba:os world it implements.

capabilities.description: Granted device/world imports (no ambient authority). The host rejects any import not listed. Optional per-interface channel allowlists bound the addressable surface.

channelAllowlist.description: Optional map of interface name -> list of permitted channel/node identifiers (numbers or opaque strings).

identity.description: C3/N5: a kotoba-os node holds NO platform private key. Identity is a member/operator-delegated capability (CACAO chain / delegation). serverKey MUST be false.

didCapability.description: A delegated capability reference (CACAO CID / delegation token id), NOT a private key.

neighbourhood.description: Holochain-style mesh join (ADR §D5). The node's local Datom-log segment is its source chain; peers validate via witness quorum.

peers.description: libp2p multiaddrs or peer DIDs of bootstrap neighbours.

witnessQuorum.description: Minimum witnesses required to accept a published entry (deterministic witness-index rule, ADR-2605231902).

safety.description: ADR non-goals encoded into the boot contract. R0..R4: soft-RT only (N2), no live actuation (N3). civilianOnly is an immutable true (N1: no weapons/fire-control, Charter Rider 2(a) / force-separation).

realtimeClass.description: soft = scan-cycle determinism only (R0..R4). hard = IEC 61508 SILx path, R5, Council Lv7+ gated.

liveActuation.description: Physical actuation on hardware. MUST be false at R0..R4 (stage-only / simulation). true requires R5 Council Lv7+ + operator gate.
